subject.title: Modular Dashboard: agent-composable Control UI workspaces (tracking)

question: Should OpenClaw accept an enabled bundled dashboard workspace plugin with agent-authored widgets, or should this stay external/narrower until storage and sandbox policy are settled?
rationale: The request fits the web-frontend ergonomics direction but creates new bundled product surface, persistent state, gateway methods, agent tools, and browser sandbox trust boundaries that automation cannot approve as policy.

options.title: Review the stacked PRs base-first
options.body: Use the linked PRs as the implementation path, but require maintainers to settle SQLite-vs-workspace-json storage and the custom-widget sandbox boundary before merge.

options.title: Narrow to plugin APIs first
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask the contributor to split out only missing generic plugin/API seams before revisiting the bundled dashboard experience.

options.title: Move the feature outside core
options.body: Reject the bundled core direction and ask for a ClawHub or external plugin experiment instead of an enabled-by-default OpenClaw dashboard surface.

recommendation.title: Review the stacked PRs base-first
recommendation.body: Use the linked PRs as the implementation path, but require maintainers to settle SQLite-vs-workspace-json storage and the custom-widget sandbox boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the recent Control UI plugin-tab seam and the Control UI direction this proposal builds on.
